sources.title: Independent prototype assumptions
sources.section: Synthetic net income threshold, freshness, retries, calendar conventions, domestic salary automation and human review

assumptions: 2700 RON minimum net income is synthetic, not a verified official net salary or bank threshold.
Effective dates bound this demo snapshot, not the bank's complete policy validity.
Freshness windows, income recency, timeout and retry settings are demo assumptions.
Calendar-month clamping and completed-year age boundaries are explicit demo conventions.
Only domestic salary has automatic rules; other income requires manual review.
No FICO cutoff, reporting threshold as rejection rule, or lender portfolio exception is invented.
All verification providers are synthetic; every submitted application needs human review.
